genxml.title: Origin 300 hub crosstalk-side register window
genxml.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/ip35-hub-errors.md
genxml.doc: Origin 300 hub crosstalk-side window: the link status doubleword, the register tested by the error path, the request-buffer table the I/O error scan reads and the widget part numbers the kernel compares.

struct.name: LLP_CSR
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/ip35-hub-errors.md
struct.doc: Link control and status doubleword that the early widget probe reads. Only bit 13 is described. With it clear, the probe returns -1 for the part, revision and manufacturer without touching the widget. Whether the bit means link up is inferred from how the I/O error interrupt set-up uses it.

struct.name: FLAGS
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/ip35-hub-errors.md
struct.doc: The register the kernel's error path tests before it goes on to the widget error handler.

struct.name: CRB_A
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/ip35-hub-errors.md
struct.doc: Request-buffer table. Entry i (0 to 14) has three 64-bit words, crb_a, crb_b and crb_c, at the register offsets below plus the stride times i; the scan reads all fifteen entries in order. See CRB_STRIDE and CRB_COUNT.
